_doc: WhatsApp Channels have NO public web preview or API a bot can read, so they
cannot be scraped automatically (unlike Telegram t.me/s/ previews).
They are a MANUAL tier: an admin follows them on a phone and forwards useful
paper PDFs / MCQ images into the StudentUp bot DM (/inbox) or drops files into
data/pdf_inbox/. The collector ingests them like any other paper.
Only channels run by known publishers/coaching brands are listed; unverified
how_to_add: Append {name,url,exams,lang,verified} — verify the link is shown on the publisher's own website first.
